name: Capsule CRM
description:
Chat with your Capsule CRM directly in Claude. Ask who you should follow up with, find contacts, review your pipeline, prep for meetings, or get quick reports on what matters most - in plain, everyday language.

You can also ask Claude to update custom fields on contacts, opportunities and projects. Claude uses your live Capsule data and respects your existing permissions.

Available on Growth plan and above.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Capsule CRM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Capsule CRM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-server.capsulecrm.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Capsule CRM MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Capsule CRM lists 39 MCP tools, including calculate_value_of_opportunities, create_task, get_board, get_contact, get_current_user, get_custom_field, get_entry, get_lost_reason, get_milestone, get_opportunity, get_pipeline, and get_project.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Capsule CRM?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Capsule CRM in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Capsule CRM MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Capsule CRM requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Capsule CRM is developed by Capsule. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
